acceptance: A resumed cycle whose Build floor reports a test-audit finding in this cycle's predicate package reruns TDD with the finding, at the first rejection.
The fresh loop and the resume loop call one reroute decision; no second copy of the rule exists.
The one-reroute-per-cycle cap holds across the resume.
fix: Route the resume path's correction through the same tddOwnedFailures and tddReroute decision as the fresh loop, so one rule decides for both.
source: console 2026-11-23: accepted risk of item build-floor-finding-in-a-tdd-file-routes-to-tdd (design section 7)
summary: The fix for build-floor-finding-in-a-tdd-file-routes-to-tdd reroutes a test-audit finding in this cycle's acs/cycle<N> package to TDD at the first rejection, but only in the fresh correction loop (cyclerun_correction.go). The resume path (resume.go:438-474) has no reroute, so a resumed Build that meets the same finding still gives the Builder a correction it may not apply, and the cycle fails as cycles 2599 and 2606 did.
title: A resumed Build reroutes a TDD-owned floor finding to TDD, as a fresh Build does
